assumptions: Requirement IDs were supplied without individual definitions; coverage descriptions map them to task clauses in order.
The named fixture paths resolve beneath evals/, as confirmed by locating and reading only the named fixture files.
Local preinstalled Node 24, TypeScript API, Playwright, and Chrome may be used without installation.
decisions: Single monotonic submission counter checked in both fulfillment and rejection prevents stale state changes without cancellation.
Search remains enabled during requests; each submission clears prior results and announces a fresh pending message.
Persistent polite status region announces loading and outcomes; cards are outside the live region. Retry restores input focus before hiding its control.
Retry saves the failed submitted query independently of the editable input.
System fonts, warm paper palette, green controls, responsive two-card grid; no external asset or font requests.
